# NM&J Hair Braiding

> Black-and-gold braid studio based in Austin, Texas. Knotless, box braids, cornrows, stitch braids, twists and locs in Suite 116 on W Slaughter Ln. Neat parts, a clean studio, and a braider clients call nice, professional and amazing.

- Phone: (512) 375-0811
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, Manchaca, Buda, Kyle
- Google and Booksy rating: 5.0 from 9 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/nmandj-hair-braiding/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/nmandj-hair-braiding/book.html

## Services
- Knotless & box braids: Knotless and box braids from small to jumbo, with clean, even parts and natural black or honey blends.
- Boho & goddess braids: Knotless braids with loose curls through the length, from natural black to honey and blonde.
- Cornrows & feed-ins: Straight-back cornrows and feed-in braids with crisp lines, for men, women and kids.
- Stitch braids & ponytails: Stitch braids pulled into a high ponytail, in natural black or with a pop of red or copper.
- Fulani, lemonade & designs: Side-swept lemonade braids, Fulani and tribal braids, and curved or spiral cornrow designs.
- Locs & twists: Loc retwists, repairs and new locs, plus Senegalese, passion and two-strand twists.

## About
NM&J Hair Braiding started out as home-based braiding in South Austin. Today it is a studio in Suite 116 at 2110 W Slaughter Ln, open every day from 8 AM to 6 PM, with black chairs on gold bases, glowing arched mirrors, warm white walls and a light-wood floor. Clients book with Pierrette on Booksy, and they keep saying the same things: she is nice, professional and amazing, the studio is clean, and the braids get compliments. One client even got a free hair wash before her style. The line on her menu says it best: "Let me make your hair shining."

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online on Booksy (tap any Book on Booksy button) or call (512) 375-0811. Bring a photo of the style you want.
- Q: How much do braids cost?
  A: Prices start at $60 for cornrows and $150 for box braids or feed-ins. The full list is in the braid menu on the Services page and on Booksy. Final price depends on size, length and hair.
- Q: Can I come in for a consultation first?
  A: Yes. Booksy has a free 30-minute consultation, so you can talk through the style, size and length before you book.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Open every day from 8 AM to 6 PM. Holiday hours can change, so call (512) 375-0811 if you are not sure.
- Q: Do you braid kids' and men's hair?
  A: Yes. Kids' braids are on the menu and the studio is child-friendly. Cornrows, designs, twists and loc styling for men are part of the work in the gallery.
- Q: Where are you, and is there parking?
  A: Suite 116, 2110 W Slaughter Ln, Austin, TX 78748, in South Austin. There is parking and the studio is wheelchair accessible. An easy drive from Sunset Valley, Manchaca, Buda and Kyle.
